patch.value: Mandatory exact-head DeepScan and CodeFactor zero-new-issues release gate

Make hosted static analysis a hard, locally executable release criterion. Verify the current Git commit's DeepScan status explicitly reports zero new issues and the CodeFactor check completes successfully with No issues found; fail on missing, pending, stale, skipped, or ambiguous results. Wire the verifier into strict release readiness, document the pushed-head prerequisite, test every state at literal 100% coverage, and require both app contexts in main branch protection.

A local exact-head command fails for DeepScan findings, CodeFactor findings, absent checks, pending checks, and analyzer payloads that do not prove zero new issues; it passes only when DeepScan explicitly reports zero new issues and CodeFactor explicitly reports no issues for git HEAD; strict release readiness invokes the command; main branch protection requires both DeepScan and CodeFactor; focused tests, lint, typecheck, full literal 100/100/100/100 coverage, hosted checks, and manual pushed-head verification pass.

value.text: Policy evidence: main branch protection was updated through the GitHub API without weakening any existing requirement. strict=true now requires both app-backed CodeFactor and DeepScan status contexts; CodeFactor remained app-bound (app_id 25603), and DeepScan was added as its legacy commit-status context. Focused TDD passes 32/32 tests; the first validator was correctly rejected by local complexity 20>16, then decomposed into analyzer-specific validators and pnpm quality:static passed without suppressions or threshold changes.

value.author: claude-code-agent
value.text: Local verification evidence: focused hosted-analysis/release-runner suite passes 42/42 tests after adding branch-protection policy cases. Complete sandboxed coverage passes 360/360 files and 6,284/6,284 tests at exact 100% statements (43,175/43,175), branches (30,627/30,627), functions (8,775/8,775), and lines (41,958/41,958). pnpm lint passes ESLint, zero jscpd clones across 745 files/416,942 lines, CodeFactor parity static quality, exact docstring coverage, package boundary, and token budgets. Typecheck, docs/skills, contracts, secret scan, and version policy pass. Manual packed-package consumer smoke in a fresh temporary directory passed init/create/update/comment, three exact-item mutation events, strict history verification, storage/history validation, and health.

value.author: claude-code-agent
value.text: Hosted analyzer status must be verified against the full immutable Git SHA and paired with branch-protection policy. A green app result is insufficient if its context is not required; missing, pending, skipped, or ambiguous payloads must fail closed. Run whole-repository coverage serially because concurrent Vitest coverage processes intentionally collide on coverage/.tmp and invalidate evidence.
